As long as the economy is strong repayments continue, but at the first sign of weakness the customers in that socioeconomic band default disproportionately. External investors cannot properly evaluate the loan book quality and therefore face catastrophic information asymmetry: making one to two percent on each loan when it goes well and losing 100% when it goes badly.
